description: Several large pastel LEGO-style blocks are spread out on the bed in front of the hands. The left hand slides a blue block toward the center while the right hand lifts a white block and sets it next to the blue, then the right hand places a green block on top of the white; next, the left hand brings a yellow block in to stack on the growing base as the right hand adds a purple block to the side and finishes by placing a blue block on top, forming a small stepped tower.
